fields.summary_ko.0: Advantest raised fiscal 2026 revenue guidance from JPY 171.4 billion to JPY 186.3 billion, and operating profit from JPY 84.6 billion to JPY 96.7 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: H1 2026 revenue reached JPY 84.52 billion, up 60.5% year-over-year, with operating profit of JPY 45.68 billion, up 96.5%, driven primarily by AI semiconductor-related demand and high-complexity products.
fields.summary_ko.2: Trading at EUR 209.90, with accelerated production capacity expansion and JPY 10.59 billion in share buybacks driving shareholder returns.
